title: Aptamer 2-step conjugation protocol (EMD Adaptation)
author: Jorge Fernandez Mendez
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8h7ht9n
materials: Reconstitute the aptamers by pipetting 100 μL of 8μM dolution on an empty eppendorf tube. Place in a thermoblock at 95 ºC for 10 minutes. And move the tube quickly to an ice bath, letting them to cool down for 10 minutes more. The reconstituted aptamer can be kept at 4ºC for several weeks, or store freezed at -20 ºC for long periods.

steps.title: Prepare sulfo‑NHS 200 mM solution
steps.instruction: Weigh 22.1 mg sulfo‑NHS, dissolve in 500 µL distilled water to make a 200 mM aqueous solution. Store at 4 °C; solution remains stable for a few months.

steps.title: Prepare EDC 200 mM solution
steps.instruction: Pipette 22 µL of 97 % EDC into 484 µL distilled water, mix to obtain a 200 mM solution. Store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Make 8 µM aptamer dilution
steps.instruction: Combine 8 µL of 100 µM 5'‑amino‑modified aptamer stock with 92 µL distilled water to yield an 8 µM solution.

steps.title: Dilute latex bead stock in MES
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL MES buffer to 200 µL of 2.5 % wt latex bead stock, bringing total volume to 500 µL.

steps.title: Wash beads and ensure dispersion
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the bead suspension at 12 000 rpm for 5 min, discard supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 500 µL MES buffer. Perform repeated pipetting (aspirate and expel) to achieve a homogeneous suspension; if aggregates persist, reduce centrifugation time or sonicate the beads for 5 min at moderate power.

steps.title: Repeat wash, final resuspension in 1 mL MES
steps.instruction: Repeat the wash described in step 5 two additional times. After the second repeat, resuspend the beads in 1000 µL MES buffer (instead of 500 µL).

steps.title: Activate beads with sulfo‑NHS
steps.instruction: Add 120 µL freshly prepared 200 mM sulfo‑NHS solution to the bead tube and mix.

steps.title: Activate beads with EDC
steps.instruction: Add 12.5 µL freshly prepared 200 mM EDC solution to the bead tube and mix.

steps.title: Incubate activation mixture
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at room temperature for 30 min with mild agitation (e.g., rotary wheel, intermittent vortexing, sonication, orbital shaker, or balance shaker).

steps.title: Couple aptamer to activated beads
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of the 8 µM aptamer solution prepared in step 3 to the bead suspension.

steps.title: Wash post‑coupling beads
steps.instruction: After aptamer incubation, centrifuge at 12 000 rpm for 5 min, discard supernatant, and resuspend beads in 1000 µL MES buffer. Perform two additional washes under the same conditions, but in the final wash resuspend the beads in 300 µL MES buffer.

steps.title: Incubate for conjugation completion
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at room temperature for 2 h 30 min with mild agitation.

steps.title: Quench activated groups with glycine
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of 50 mM glycine aqueous solution to the beads, mix, and let stand for 5 min.

steps.title: Final washes and block beads
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 12 000 rpm for 5 min, discard supernatant, and resuspend beads in 1000 µL blocking buffer. Repeat the wash two more times; in the final wash resuspend in 500 µL MES buffer instead of 1000 µL.

steps.title: Store conjugated beads
steps.instruction: Adjust bead concentration to 1 % wt relative to latex beads and store the suspension in blocking buffer at 4 °C; beads remain stable for several weeks.
